name: Babelize Elements
summary: Open-source React and Tailwind components for localization: language switcher, phone input and navbar.
description: Community-built library of localization UI components for React and Tailwind CSS — language switchers, locale pickers, translation widgets and RTL-aware primitives. Install the full package with npm install @babelize/elements or add components one at a time through the shadcn CLI; components work uncontrolled or controlled, ship with pluralization and RTL handling and have no framework lock-in. Documentation and live demos live at elements.babelize.co.
contains: localization UI components for React and Tailwind
installs via npm (@babelize/elements) or the shadcn CLI
uncontrolled and controlled props; pluralization and RTL built in
docs with live demos at elements.babelize.co
